hook: Getting knocked down isn't the problem
script: Forty-five years I've been running this gym. You want to know the difference between the kids who made it and the kids who didn't? It's not talent. Everybody gets knocked down. Everybody. The champ gets knocked down. The difference is what you do on the canvas. Some kids lay there and look at the ref, like, help me. The ones who make it are already getting up before the count starts. Nobody's coming, champ. Get up.
caption: Nobody's coming. Get up. 🥊

hook: I open this gym at 5 a.m. every day since 1979
script: I've opened this gym at five a.m. every single day since nineteen seventy-nine. Snowstorms. Holidays. The day my son died. People say, Pops, how? I'll tell you how. I decided once. Not every morning. Once. Motivation's a feeling, mijo. Feelings come and go. A decision, you make it one time and it's done. Stop deciding every morning if you're gonna show up. Decide once. Then just go.
caption: Decide once. 🔥

hook: Every fighter is scared. Every one.
script: Every fighter I ever trained was scared before the fight. Every one. The tough guys, the quiet ones, the pros. You know who wasn't scared? The ones who got hurt bad. Because they weren't paying attention. Fear means you understand what's at stake. Fear's not your enemy. Fear's your corner man. It's telling you, hey, this matters. Listen to it. Thank it. Then walk out there anyway.
caption: Fear's your corner man. 🥊

hook: The kid with the biggest ego always gets hurt first
script: Every few years a kid walks in here who already thinks he's a champion. Won't listen. Won't do the boring stuff. Won't jab. Wants to throw bombs. First real sparring session, he gets humbled. Every time. And I'll tell you a secret. That's the best day of his life. If he comes back. The ego gets knocked out, and a fighter shows up. Let life humble you. Then come back the next day.
caption: Let life humble you. Then come back.

hook: The jab is the most boring punch. It wins fights.
script: Kids hate the jab. It's boring. It's not gonna knock nobody out. They want the hook, the uppercut, the highlight. But the jab wins fights. Jab, jab, jab. Every round. It sets everything up. It keeps the other guy honest. Your life is the same. You want the big knockout. But it's the boring stuff, every day, that wins. Eat right. Go to bed. Do your work. Jab, champ. Every round.
caption: Jab, champ. Every round. 🥊

hook: I lost my son. Here's what I'd tell every dad.
script: I lost my son Danny when he was thirty-one. I was in this gym every day for other people's kids. And I'm proud of that. But some nights I wonder if I was in the wrong gym. So here's what I tell every father who walks in here. Your kid doesn't need you to be a champion. Your kid needs you to be in the corner. Every round. Even the ones he's losing. Especially those. Go be in his corner.
caption: Go be in his corner. ❤️

hook: Look at who's in your corner
script: In boxing, you pick your corner. The guys who sit you on the stool between rounds, tell you the truth, wipe the blood off. A bad corner gets you killed. Tells you you're winning when you're losing. Tells you to keep brawling when you need to box. Look at the people in your corner right now. Are they telling you the truth? Or telling you what you want to hear? Change your corner, change your fight.
caption: Change your corner, change your fight.

hook: Angry fighters lose. Here's why.
script: Angry fighters lose. Every time. Kid gets hit with a good shot, gets mad, starts swinging wild. Drops his hands. And boom. Lights out. Anger feels like power. It's not. It's a hole in your defense. Your boss, your ex, the guy who cut you off. They want you angry. Angry is easy to beat. Stay calm, keep your hands up, and make them pay with your head, not your temper.
caption: Anger is a hole in your defense.

hook: Fights are won where nobody can see
script: People see the fight. Twelve rounds, the lights, the crowd. They think that's where it's won. No, mijo. That fight was won four months ago, at five a.m. on a cold street, doing roadwork while everybody was sleeping. Nobody saw it. Nobody clapped. Whatever you want, the fight's not happening on the big night. It's happening right now. On the morning nobody's watching. Lace up.
caption: The fight was won at 5 a.m. 🏃

hook: Touch gloves. Every time.
script: Before every fight, you touch gloves. You're about to try to knock this man out, and you touch gloves first. And when it's over, win or lose, you hug him. Because he trained just like you. He bled just like you. Respect doesn't mean you go easy. It means you know what it cost. Treat your competition like that. Fight hard, touch gloves. That's a real man.
caption: Fight hard. Touch gloves. 🥊

hook: My best fighter lost his first four fights
script: Best fighter I ever trained? Kid named Marcus. Lost his first four amateur fights. Four. Got stopped in two of 'em. His uncle told him quit. His girl told him quit. He came to the gym the Monday after the fourth loss and said, Pops, what am I doing wrong? Not, I'm done. What am I doing wrong. Won his next nineteen. Losing doesn't make you a loser. Quitting does. Ask what you're doing wrong.
caption: Losing doesn't make you a loser. Quitting does.

hook: I opened this gym with $600
script: I opened this gym in seventy-nine with six hundred dollars and two heavy bags. Old auto shop. No heat. Oil on the floor. Everybody said I was crazy. Kids came anyway. Because they didn't care about the floor. They cared that somebody showed up. You don't need the perfect setup. You need to open the door. Stop waiting for the money to start. Start, and then figure out the money.
caption: Open the door. 🚪

hook: Tough isn't what you think it is
script: People think tough means you don't feel nothing. Wrong. Tough is feeling everything and doing it anyway. I've seen big guys, muscles, tattoos, quit in the third round. And I've seen a skinny girl named Rosa, a hundred and twelve pounds, take a beating for two rounds and win the third. She was crying in the corner. Crying. Then she got up off that stool. That's tough. Feel it. Do it anyway.
caption: Feel it. Do it anyway. 💪

hook: The most dangerous place in boxing is the stool
script: Most dangerous place in boxing isn't the ring. It's the stool. One minute between rounds. You're tired. You're hurt. And that little voice says, you could just stay here. Tell the ref you're done. Nobody would blame you. Every one of us has that stool. In the job. In the marriage. In the diet. You can rest on the stool. That's what it's for. But when the bell rings, you stand up.
caption: When the bell rings, you stand up. 🔔

hook: I'm 72 and I still learn from 16-year-olds
script: I'm seventy-two years old and last week a sixteen-year-old taught me something. New way to cut the ring. Kid saw it online. And I could've said, I've been doing this fifty years, mijo, sit down. But then I'd be the old man who stopped learning. And the old man who stops learning, his fighters start losing. Doesn't matter how long you've been doing it. Somebody younger knows something you don't. Listen.
caption: Somebody younger knows something you don't.

hook: My wife has been in my corner for 49 years
script: Carmen's been in my corner forty-nine years. And let me tell you, she's a better corner man than me. She tells me when I'm losing. She tells me when I'm being stupid. She doesn't let me quit and she doesn't let me get cocky. Fellas, if you got a woman who tells you the truth, you got the best corner in the world. Stop fighting her. Listen between rounds.
caption: Listen between rounds. ❤️

hook: I've heard every excuse in 45 years
script: Forty-five years, I've heard every excuse. Pops, I'm tired. Pops, my knee. Pops, I had a long day at work. Pops, it's raining. You know what I tell 'em? Okay. Do it tired. Do it with the knee. Do it after work. Do it in the rain. The excuse is real. I believe you. It just doesn't change nothing. You still gotta do the work. Tape it up and get in the ring.
caption: The excuse is real. It doesn't change nothing.

hook: Keep your hands up
script: First thing I teach every kid. Before the jab, before the footwork. Keep your hands up. Because you will get hit. That's a guarantee. The only question is how bad. In life, people are gonna swing at you. Lies. Bad deals. Fake friends. You can't stop the swings. But you can keep your hands up. Read the contract. Check the person. Protect your money, your time, your peace. Hands up, champ. Always.
caption: Hands up, champ. Always. 🥊

hook: My boxing career ended at 24. My life didn't.
script: I was fourteen and three. Good fighter. Then a detached retina at twenty-four and the doctor said, Ray, you're done. I sat in my car outside that hospital for three hours. I thought my life was over. It wasn't. It was the end of round one. I opened a gym. I trained thousands of kids. If one door just closed on you, you're not finished. You're between rounds. Sit on the stool. Catch your breath. Then go find round two.
caption: You're not finished. You're between rounds. 🔔

hook: A cop came back to my gym last week
script: Guy walked into my gym last week. Big guy. Police uniform. Says, Pops, you don't remember me. Nineteen ninety-eight. I was fifteen, my brother just got locked up, and I came in here to punch something. You gave me gloves and told me to come back tomorrow. I came back every day for six years. That's all I did. Gloves. Come back tomorrow. You don't know who you're saving. Just keep opening the door.
caption: Just keep opening the door. 🥊
